vis.scope: Existing MeasurementSet furnishing antenna positions, feed angles and field names. The gain table supplies the FIELD delay direction.

tablein.scope: Existing gain calibration table with two receptor amplitudes and flags at the first channel.

caltable.scope: Optional independent corrected gain table. The task preserves an existing destination and publishes a new output after successful correction.

paoffset.scope: Position-angle offset in degrees added to the first receptor angle. Positive and negative offsets and invalid numerical inputs have paired coverage.

minpacov.scope: Minimum unflagged parallactic-angle coverage in degrees, with at least three samples required for each fit. Antennas without a fit use the window mean in a corrected table.

behaviors.title: Gain-ratio fractional polarization
behaviors.scope: Two fields and two spectral windows with independently planted per-antenna polarization, mixed receptor flags, sparse antenna coverage, distinct calibration and MeasurementSet FIELD directions, channel preservation and a rank-one fit.
behaviors.gap: The difference in publication after a failed correction is documented below.

decisions.inputs: Request a corrected caltable when an unflagged gain is nonfinite.
decisions.casa: Raises Spurious fractional polarization! after creating the copied destination.
decisions.ours: Raises the same diagnostic and leaves the requested destination absent.
decisions.rationale: Publishing after correction keeps incomplete calibration tables from downstream tasks.
decisions.impact: The caller can retry immediately with corrected input.

paired.kind: Same-input Python task and casacore interchange
paired.scope: Two fields and two spectral windows with independently planted per-antenna polarization, mixed receptor flags, sparse antenna coverage, distinct calibration and MeasurementSet FIELD directions, channel preservation and a rank-one fit.
paired.result: 240 first-channel complex gains matched exactly after CASA readback. All argument, scale, flag and metadata cases passed.
